test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

I could not make out what / it is, for the wind was / rustling the corn-shocks.

options.text: I could not make out what
it is, for the wind was

solution:
The correct answer is:"**it is, for the wind was**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**it is**" is not necessary in this sentence and creates an error in parallelism.
 
• The **correct sentence** would be "*I could not make out what was rustling the corn-shocks, for the wind was...*"
 
• This creates parallelism between the two clauses in the sentence.
 
• Parallelism is the repetition of grammatical elements in a piece of writing to create a harmonious effect.
 
• It can involve repeating the exact same words, such as in the common phrases "easy come, easy go" and "I came, I saw, I conquered".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
